kinds.d: Roasted grains sold to brew as a caffeine-free tea, hot or cold.
Roasted roots or grains sold to brew as a caffeine-free alternative to coffee.

notes: Restraint only. Roasted barley tea widened to Roasted grain tea (types barley, corn, buckwheat, brown rice), keeping the old Tokyo Mugicha model; Roasted chicory widened to Coffee substitutes (types chicory, dandelion root, grain coffee). Old sources kept. Nothing dropped; no new kinds, no web research.
